title: manuscript-guard registration record
description: What a registry said of one of the study's registrations, on one day. `manuscript-guard lookup --registrations` writes it to design/registrations/<id>.yaml for ClinicalTrials.gov, the EU PAS register, OSF and ISRCTN, with a digest of what it says; G12 reads it offline. A registry it does not ask, PROSPERO among them, has a record copied by hand (`source: by-hand`), which names who copied it and when, and has no digest.

date.description: A date as far as the registry gives it: a day, a month or a year.

label.description: The registry's own name for the field.

role.description: For an outcome field: primary or secondary where the registry keeps them apart, `other` for ClinicalTrials.gov's other pre-specified outcomes, `outcomes` for a field that holds them all.

registered.description: When the registry received the registration.

study_start.description: The study's actual start as the registry gives it: ClinicalTrials.gov's start date of type ACTUAL, the EU PAS register's actual start of data collection, ISRCTN's recruitment start. An estimated or planned date is not kept.

analysis_start.description: The EU PAS register's actual start of data analysis.

updated.description: The registry's last update of the record.

copied_by.description: Who copied a by-hand record from the registry's page.

first_version.description: OSF only, where the registration was updated after it was first registered: what it said first. The outcomes are held to this version.

reason.description: The justification OSF holds for the update.
